title: Choose the homepage composition
question: Which Teletext composition should become the Workroom homepage? Use the steer field to combine or revise details.

options.label: A — Broadcast Index
options.lineage: teletext front page plus feature magazine
options.thesis: The offer, product proof, and three capability channels all land within one scan.
options.viewport: Headline and beta download sit beside the app; a factual ticker introduces three dense proof channels.
options.risk: The equal feature columns can make the second half feel more like an index than a guided story.

options.label: B — Split Broadcast
options.thesis: The real app becomes the dominant transmission while the offer occupies one focused control panel.
options.viewport: A large product capture occupies the left; the action and explanation remain fixed on the right.
options.risk: The controlled split is exceptionally clear but less exuberant than the other compositions.

options.label: C — Magazine Rail
options.lineage: numbered teletext magazine with vertical page rail
options.thesis: A persistent direct-address rail turns the whole homepage into a navigable Workroom broadcast.
options.viewport: A full magazine index frames the headline, current screenshot, capability channels, and Git/JJ diagram.
options.risk: The dense rail carries the world most fully, but it needs careful mobile translation to stay fast and legible.
